left.raw_text: Histologically confirmed PD-L1 status defined NSCLC. Biopsy must be within 70 days of first treatment with pembrolizumab.
Uni-dimensionally measurable disease according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours (RECIST) v1.1.
Computerised Tomography (CT) scan of chest and abdomen within 28 days of starting pembrolizumab.
Adequate haematological function: Platelet count ≥100 x 109 /L. Neutrophils ≥1.5 x 109/L. Haemoglobin ≥ 9g/dL.
Adequate hepatic function: Serum bilirubin ≤1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN). Serum transaminases ≤2.5 x ULN.

AND.raw_text: Adequate renal function: Creatinine clearance <1.5 times ULN concurrent with creatinine clearance >50 ml/min.
Provision of signed and dated, written informed consent prior to any study specific procedures, sampling and analyses.
